changes: Parent context-service dispatch is bounded at 64 operations including response writing; worker-side pending limit remains 32.
Over-budget context peers are disconnected without creating another dispatch thread; RAII releases capacity on exit and thread creation errors are handled.
Network message allocation and publication share the writer lock, preserving monotonic wire order under concurrent start/cancel calls.
Context, network, worker message and worker session identifiers reject exhaustion instead of wrapping or saturating reuse.
clippy: native V8 library passes with warnings denied
earlier_attempt: The restricted network suite passed 22 tests and failed its HTTP/2 listener fixture with PermissionDenied. The same 23-test suite passed with loopback permission; the final full suite also passed with that permission.
